info.title: AgentReady public API
info.summary: Free AI sales-visibility scanner: score any website 0–100 on how discoverable and parseable it is for AI shopping agents.
info.description:
AgentReady's free public endpoints — no signup, no API key, CORS-open.

- `GET /api/scan` — instant agent-readiness scan of any website: robots.txt access for the major AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended), llms.txt and agents.md presence, schema.org JSON-LD structured data (Product, Offer, Organization, FAQPage), sitemap discoverability and answer-readiness metadata — returned as a 0–100 score with itemized checks and concrete fixes.
- `GET /api/verify/status` — public verification status of an Agent-Ready Verified badge (no PII exposed).
- `GET /badge/{id}.svg` — the embeddable Agent-Ready Verified badge image, kept honest by weekly automated re-verification.

Please self-limit to a few requests per minute per target. A pay-per-call version of the scan for autonomous agents (x402 protocol, USDC on Base, no account) is documented at https://x402.agiscorecard.com/openapi.json.

license.name: Proprietary — free public API, fair-use rate limits apply

get.summary: Free agent-readiness scan of any website
get.description: Fetches the target's robots.txt, llms.txt, agents.md, homepage and sitemap, runs the full check suite and returns a 0–100 score with itemized pass/warn/fail checks and concrete fixes. Free, no auth. Private/local hosts are rejected.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target URL to scan (scheme optional — `https://` is assumed).

400.description: Missing or invalid url parameter, or a private/local host.

422.description: The target could not be reached.

get.description: Public verification status for a badge id: current score, grade, whether the badge is paid and actively passing its weekly re-verification. Exposes no email or token.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Badge/verification id (as found in the badge URL `/badge/{id}.svg`).

404.description: No verification record for this id.

get.description: The live badge image for a verification id. Renders "verified" (paid + passing), "check failing" (paid but currently regressed), "preview" (eligible, unpaid) or "unverified" (unknown id). Cacheable for 1 hour; CORS-open, safe to hot-link from any site.

200.description: SVG badge image (always 200 — unknown ids render the "unverified" badge).

Check.description: One itemized check in the scan report.

fix.description: Concrete fix suggestion; null when the check passes.

url.description: Normalized target URL that was scanned.

summary.description: One-line human summary of the result.

verified.description: True when the badge is paid AND currently passing re-verification.

active.description: True when the last re-scan met the verification threshold.

threshold.description: Minimum score required to be verified.
